compatibilityAndNecessaryDifferences: Legacy table/controller page and loadNext/previous method signatures remain compatibility boundaries; the common view binds no-op paging and does not call the network on scroll.
_visiblePresentationActive controls covered-route and local geometry handling only. Viewport, focused and keyboard-neighbour rows remain mounted locally; this is not neighbouring network pages.
PreparedPageRead holds only one explicitly prepared bounded category first batch and its existing physical read budget; maximumQueries limits distinct preparations, not scrolling list pages.
PDF/printing pages and text layout remain real paper/file boundaries. Warehouse print preview retains its original2000-row contract; it is not the business list source.
Business write/selection limits, original approved command splitting, CAS/version and unknown-write protection are unchanged; reading all rows does not expand command authority.
Visible expandable detail sections or short warning summaries keep an explicit complete entry where applicable; private slices with no route to the tail were removed.
AI context caps, bounded name enrichment/ID chunks and source-tree path prefixes remain purpose-specific work; they do not truncate business display rows.
Public SEO directory pagination and the external visitor minimum2-character/top5 privacy search retain their original public contract.
WPF full ERP and Win7 target-device acceptance are separate from the already implemented native screens; current WPF history followup has its own fresh receipt.
snapshotBoundary: Multiple HTTP batches are one complete current-query collection, not an invented shared database MVCC snapshot. Supplied scope/revision/HWM, cardinality, page shape and immutable IDs are checked; detectable drift fails without a false complete/zero, and writes remain server authoritative.
